title: Hanna treks through the desert (paraphrase C)
topic: A photographer named Hanna travels through a desert: dunes in the evening light, a night in tents near a well, a caravan at dawn, packing for the journey home
tail_E: For the ride back the guide helps Hanna onto the back of a kneeling
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'camel' is predictable only from the desert context (desert, dunes, sand, a well, a caravan); the riding animal that kneels to be mounted in the desert is the camel ('the guide' is the native guide of unit 3). The word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither does its German equivalent 'Kamel'. ' camel' is a single Pythia token (id 46493). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' camel') = 0.26 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' horse' 0.11).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV03C, photographer Hanna, paraphrase C, development family)
notes: Formulation C: third independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV03A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Hanna, wording different from A and B). Replacements include treks through the desert with a camera (zieht durch die Wüste mit einer Kamera - 'durch' is the preposition of 'die Wüste'), sun beats down on the scorching sand (Sonne brütet über dem glühenden Sand - 'brüten' in the sense of sweltering heat), native guide accompanies her to a towering dune (ortskundiger Führer begleitet sie zu einer gewaltigen Düne), shoots the dunes in the soft evening light (knipst die Dünen im sanften Abendlicht), desert wind drives fine sand across the path (Wüstenwind treibt feinen Sand über den Pfad), the party rests in tents by an old well (Reisegruppe ruht in Zelten an einem alten Brunnen), stars gleam above the hushed desert (Sterne glänzen über der schweigenden Wüste), fits a different lens just before sunrise (montiert ein anderes Objektiv kurz vor Sonnenaufgang), big caravan comes to the well at sunrise (große Karawane kommt zum Brunnen bei Sonnenaufgang), fills her suitcases for the return trip (füllt ihre Koffer für die Rückfahrt). No separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
